title: Localize a product for a new market
summary: Before committing to a commercial launch in a market with different user, language or operating needs. A tested localized offer with approved market-entry requirements, support and a controlled launch decision.
outcomes: A tested localized offer with approved market-entry requirements, support and a controlled launch decision.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before committing to a commercial launch in a market with different user, language or operating needs.

parts.title: Research the market and target user journeys
parts.guidance: Collect evidence on demand, language, purchasing, payments, accessibility and support expectations. Identify how the proposed market differs from current operations without assuming translation alone establishes product fit.

references.title: W3C planning and managing web accessibility

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review commercial and local requirements
parts.guidance: Product and qualified legal, tax and security owners assess the actual offer, customer terms, data flows and regulated uses. Assign unresolved licensing, entity, employment or export questions to their specialist processes.

references.title: W3C planning and managing web accessibility

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Prepare the localized product and operating plan
parts.guidance: Adapt content, formats, documentation, support and commercial configuration using reviewed terminology. Track integrations, pricing and fulfillment changes and keep unsupported promises out of marketing.

references.title: W3C planning and managing web accessibility

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Test with representative local users
parts.guidance: Run critical onboarding, product, payment, accessibility and support journeys with authorized test data. Capture defects and comprehension problems and confirm readiness against agreed acceptance criteria.

references.title: W3C planning and managing web accessibility

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Approve a bounded launch and monitor outcomes
parts.guidance: The accountable owners verify required approvals and operating capacity, then authorize the launch scope. Monitor customer outcomes and incidents and assign owners for changes before broad expansion.

references.title: W3C planning and managing web accessibility
